Ptilopsis:Malloc.NAME: malloc
Ptilopsis:Malloc.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL ptilopsis:Construct X empty Mutable ptilopsis:Threads.
Ptilopsis:Malloc.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL ptilopsis:Construct X empty Mutable ptilopsis:Threads. NL If X is at least 1, gain [E].

Ptilopsis:Silence.NAME: Silence
Ptilopsis:Silence.DESCRIPTION: At turn start, choose 1 of 3 random class cards. Repeat 1 time. NL ptilopsis:Mount the 2 chosen cards in 1 new Mutable ptilopsis:Thread.
Ptilopsis:Silence.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: At turn start, choose 1 of 3 random class cards. Repeat 1 time. NL ptilopsis:Mount the 2 chosen cards in 1 new Mutable ptilopsis:Thread. NL Trigger this effect 1 time now.

Ptilopsis:Saria.NAME: Saria
Ptilopsis:Saria.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage 3 times. NL ptilopsis:Stun the target. NL ptilopsis:Construct a ptilopsis:Calcification ptilopsis:Thread.
Ptilopsis:Saria.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage 3 times. NL ptilopsis:Stun the target. NL ptilopsis:Construct a ptilopsis:Calcification+ ptilopsis:Thread.

Ptilopsis:CalcificationGuard.NAME: Calcification
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Whenever you gain Block, gain 1 extra Block. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Double your current Block.

Ptilopsis:MedicalInstruction.NAME: Medic: Instruction
Ptilopsis:MedicalInstruction.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! Vulnerable and deal !D! damage. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: Deal #b3 damage to ALL enemies. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Deal #b6 damage to ALL enemies.
Ptilopsis:MedicalInstruction.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! Vulnerable and deal !D! damage. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: Deal #b4 damage to ALL enemies. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Deal #b8 damage to ALL enemies.

Ptilopsis:BloodBrainBarrier.NAME: Blood-Brain Barrier
Ptilopsis:BloodBrainBarrier.DESCRIPTION: Immediately trigger ALL enemies' ptilopsis:Master_Theorem and its decay. NL Gain Block equal to the total damage dealt.
Ptilopsis:BloodBrainBarrier.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Apply 3 ptilopsis:Master_Theorem to ALL enemies. NL Immediately trigger ALL enemies' ptilopsis:Master_Theorem and its decay. NL Gain Block equal to the total damage dealt.

Ptilopsis:GradientDescent.NAME: Gradient Descent
Ptilopsis:GradientDescent.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Construct 1 fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: Apply !M! ptilopsis:Master_Theorem to a random enemy. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Apply !M! ptilopsis:Master_Theorem to ALL enemies.

Ptilopsis:GradientStep.NAME: Gradient Step
Ptilopsis:GradientStep.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! ptilopsis:Master_Theorem to a random enemy.

Ptilopsis:MemoryLeak.NAME: Memory Leak
Ptilopsis:MemoryLeak.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Draw !M! cards. NL Add 1 copy of this card to your hand.

Ptilopsis:BootThread.NAME: Boot Thread
Ptilopsis:BootThread.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Construct 1 empty Mutable ptilopsis:Thread. NL Gain !B! Block. NL Draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:ReadOnlyThread.NAME: Read-Only Thread
Ptilopsis:ReadOnlyThread.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Retain. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Construct and ptilopsis:Function: Gain !B! Block. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.NAME: Wake Routine
Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.DESCRIPTION: Draw 1 card. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL At turn start, draw 1 card. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Gain [E] and draw 1 card.
Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Draw 1 card. NL ptilopsis:Construct 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL At turn start, draw 1 card. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Gain [E] and draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:CacheRefresh.NAME: Cache Refresh
Ptilopsis:CacheRefresh.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Draw 1 card. NL Draw 1 more for each ptilopsis:Thread with a ptilopsis:Function.

Ptilopsis:Enkephalin.NAME: Enkephalin
Ptilopsis:Enkephalin.DESCRIPTION: Each turn, when you first play a card manually, ptilopsis:Mount its ptilopsis:Function for free and draw 1 card.
Ptilopsis:Enkephalin.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Gain 1 ptilopsis:Thread slot. NL Each turn, when you first play a card manually, ptilopsis:Mount its ptilopsis:Function for free and draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:DivideAndConquer.NAME: Divide and Conquer
Ptilopsis:DivideAndConquer.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Apply 12 ptilopsis:Master_Theorem to ALL enemies.

Ptilopsis:ProtocolConcurrency.NAME: Protocol Concurrency
Ptilopsis:ProtocolConcurrency.DESCRIPTION: Trigger all ptilopsis:Threads' end-of-turn effects 1 time.

Ptilopsis:CoroutineYield.NAME: Coroutine Yield
Ptilopsis:CoroutineYield.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Trigger all ptilopsis:Threads' ptilopsis:Destruct effects 1 time.

Ptilopsis:CrystallineDream.NAME: Crystalline Dream
Ptilopsis:CrystallineDream.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL ptilopsis:Destruct all your ptilopsis:Threads. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Thread destructed.
Ptilopsis:CrystallineDream.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Destruct all your ptilopsis:Threads. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Thread destructed.

Ptilopsis:Hyperthreading.NAME: Hyperthreading
Ptilopsis:Hyperthreading.DESCRIPTION: At turn end, trigger your leftmost ptilopsis:Thread's ptilopsis:Destruct effect.
Ptilopsis:Hyperthreading.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: At turn end, trigger your leftmost and rightmost ptilopsis:Threads' ptilopsis:Destruct effects 1 time each.

Ptilopsis:MergeSort.NAME: Merge Sort
Ptilopsis:MergeSort.DESCRIPTION: Sort your draw pile by cost, drawing the cheapest cards first. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Inversion before sorting.
Ptilopsis:MergeSort.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Sort your draw pile by cost, drawing the cheapest cards first. NL Gain !B! Block for each ptilopsis:Inversion before sorting. NL Draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:QuickIteration.NAME: Quick Iteration
Ptilopsis:QuickIteration.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Add !M! random Ptilopsis cards to your hand. NL They cost 0 this combat and gain Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Offline.NAME: Offline
Ptilopsis:Offline.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust up to !M! cards from your hand and pack them into 1 Fixed ptilopsis:Thread. NL ptilopsis:Function: Play copies in selection order. NL ptilopsis:Destruct: Gain !B! Block.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose cards in replay order (you may choose none)

Ptilopsis:Magallan.NAME: Magallan
Ptilopsis:Magallan.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Retain. NL Costs 1 less for each other card played this combat. NL After this turn ends, take 1 extra turn.

Ptilopsis:Rosmontis.NAME: Rosmontis
Ptilopsis:Rosmontis.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to ALL enemies. NL For each ptilopsis:Thread, deal 1 ptilopsis:Aftershock to ALL enemies for half the initial damage.

Ptilopsis:ExtremeDataConstruction.NAME: Hack it!
Ptilopsis:ExtremeDataConstruction.DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Master_Theorem you apply no longer halves after causing HP loss.
Ptilopsis:ExtremeDataConstruction.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: ptilopsis:Master_Theorem you apply no longer halves after causing HP loss. NL Draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:Muelsyse.NAME: Muelsyse
Ptilopsis:Muelsyse.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL She will help you at the right moment! NL Heal 18 HP.

Ptilopsis:Closure.NAME: Closure
Ptilopsis:Closure.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Innate. NL Lose !M! Gold, or all your Gold if you have less. NL Upgrade all your cards for this combat. NL After winning, upgrade 1 random card in your deck.
